changes.title: Bounce off
items: An enraged animal now refuses a 💌 properly: it whines, its 💢 shakes, and the letter crumples into a ball of paper and is tossed away

changes.title: Treehouse balcony
items: The treehouse has a balcony and a hub: fly straight onto the balcony at treetop height to land, walk into the round room behind it with the world map pouring into its pool, and walk off the balcony's open edge to fly again.
The camera pushes in while she's in the house, and a knockout brings her back at the magic circle behind the decks: she rises out of its floor and walks to her decks to scratch.

changes.title: Singer alto
items: The singer sings lower and gentler: an alto in tune, in short steps, each note swelling in with a breath, with no chorus or octave smearing it; she sings only in the breakdowns and the builds now, as a small choir in the breakdowns, and comes back to the same motif each wave
